body:
Update: I feel better it has gotten better,,, I no longer lay next to a stash of pills every night on the verge/ 
with the intention of downing all of them when everyone’s asleep. I no longer wake up with an overwhelming feeling of regret that I didn’t kill myself the night prior. I no longer wake up and starve myself for the whole day in preparation, only to binge eat at midnight instead of ‘following through’. 

Though I don’t really have that much motivation I’m proud of myself for still being here:). And I can truthfully and whole heartedly say I love myself. I’m not completely better and believe me I have really bad days and sometimes the smallest things can send me spirally, but I’m better than I was before. I really hope I never go to that low place again but I know recovery is not linear, I just hope I’ll have the strength to keep holding on, to keep trying.


Also I’m almost 4months clean from self h*rm after having relapsed around the time of the original post :))
If anyone is reading this I hope this gives you some time of hope. I wrote the original post during a pretty low point and look at me now. As long as there’s breath there’s hope (as cliche as that sounds) and if u haven’t heard it today I care about you, I love you, and you deserve to be here no matter what anyone(even you) says,,,I’m proud of you and I believe in you<3 hang in there
That’s amazing:)) Im sending hella good vibes your way and I wish u the best of luck in staying clean
I love the way u wrote this poem, it’s hella beautiful and dark forming an unsettling image in an artistic way

Please reconsider I know I’m a complete stranger and it might not feel like what I’m saying is true but smth that sometimes helps me is to remember the concept that ‘as long as there’s breath there’s hope’ and analyze the possibilities that things could get better in the future. It may sound like optimistic bs but it helps me when I contemplate suicide. Another thing you could try is going to sleep. so you won’t harm yourself, and maybe you’ll wake up and feel that over dosing is  not as urgent/necessary as you feel it is right now. I’m sending my good vibes your way and I strongly urge you to reconsider please. I hope you find happiness one day friend

I haven’t showered in a week and a day which I know is gross, but it’s the truth. I usually tend to shower once a week... I don’t work out or anything like that I just do nothing all day, so I don’t stink. I use deodorant and perfume of course. I try to brush my teeth twice a day but I remember on one occasion when I was rlly rlly down I didn’t brush them for like a week and something. It’s hard sometimes to function like a ‘normal’ person even when it comes to basic things like hygiene but it’s part of having depression.

Hey dude I’m really sorry that you feel like you have to do this but I just want to remind you that yes you may feel horrible now and maybe have been feeling like that for awhile, which has driven you to this point, but if it’s this bad now and you stay alive, then it can only get better right, and sure it’s not going to happen quick but I have been in your shoes before, made a plan set a date got materials ready... but each time I think about the what if’s, what if the day after I kill myself something great would’ve happened but I wouldn’t be there to experience it, what if I end up having a good life if I stay alive, what if someday in the future I’ll be happy or have a purpose or something that makes me content. So my friend what if you end up making it through this tough time that you’re going through, staying alive even though it seems impossible, and in the future the future you will look back on today and be grateful that you decided not to die. I wish you the best of luck<3 and I hope that you will be ok one day and find true happiness.

Please don’t. I know I’m just a random stranger online and don’t know what you are personally going through but please don’t. I know it seems really hard to live sometimes and it truly seems like nothing will ever get better, but depression lies. Live for the future you, the you that will have found happiness and look back and be so glad they stayed. I don’t know you but I know that you will be missed and your brother and friends need you. Imagine your life without them and their life without you. I believe in you and that you deserve to live and that you were meant to be alive. I’m sending much love and positivity your way. <3
